items.question: What does the chapter state in the source passage beginning “Æ The three pillars or organs of the government are the…”?
items.answer: Æ The three pillars or organs of the government are the legislature, the executive, and the judiciary..indd 165 02-12-2025 12:05:0402-12-2025 12:05:04 Reprint 2026-27 166 Exploring Society: India and Beyond | Grade 7 Part 2 Æ In India, there are also three levels of government — union (central), state, and local.
